UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile in the system.

uid.description: The user's unique ID from Firebase Auth.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user profile was created.

lastUpdatedAt.description: The timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

role.description: The user's role in the system. This is for display purposes; the authoritative role is in the auth token.

Service.title: Service
Service.description: Represents a service offered by the company.

description.description: A short description of the service.

icon.description: The name of the lucide-react icon for the service.

imageUrl.description: URL of the uploaded service image.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product in the inventory.

status.description: The stock status of the product.

imageId.description: The ID of the placeholder image for the product.

imageUrl.description: URL of the uploaded product image.

PricingPackage.title: Pricing Package
PricingPackage.description: Represents a pricing package for services.

name.description: The name of the package (e.g., Basic, Standard).

price.description: The price of the package. 0 for custom.

features.description: A list of features included in the package.

status.description: The status of the pricing package.

popular.description: Whether this package is marked as popular.

SurveyRequest.title: Survey Request
SurveyRequest.description: Represents a site survey request from a potential customer.

message.description: The customer's message about their needs.

status.description: The current status of the survey request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the request was submitted.

SiteSettings.title: Site Settings
SiteSettings.description: Global settings for the website, like footer content.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public information about a user.

/services/{serviceId}.description: Stores the services offered by the company.

/products/{productId}.description: Stores the products available for sale.

/survey-requests/{requestId}.description: Stores survey requests from potential customers.

/settings/footer.description: Stores the configuration for the site footer.
